name: Maharashtra verified public-data context (Mumbai anchor)
plannedPrograms: MoSPI PAIMANA state project monitoring context
sources: https://censusindia.gov.in/nada/index.php/catalog/42559
https://dashboard.udiseplus.gov.in/report2025/static/media/UDISE%2B2024_25_Booklet_existing.118ba29d4773e6372f72.pdf
https://ipm.mospi.gov.in/Content/PDF/FlashReport_March_2026.pdf
dataNotes: State-level context; not a ward-level or real-time demographic/infrastructure estimate.
Population exposure uses Maharashtra's Census 2011 population as a share of India's 2011 population baseline.
Infrastructure gap is the share of Maharashtra schools without functional electricity in UDISE+ 2024-25.
Inclusion need is the share of Maharashtra schools without functional girls' toilets in UDISE+ 2024-25.
Investment alignment is represented by cumulative expenditure divided by original project cost in the MoSPI March 2026 snapshot.
